title: Urban teachers' education-sector protest campaign; possible June resumption after pause
likely_owner: outside assigned 2023Q2 months for onset; prior onset not independently researched in this package
summary: Search-only Red Uno result reports that urban teachers began protesting February 8 and suspended pressure measures May 5; June 19 Brújula announced a June 23 resumption after a pause, and a June 27 Los Tiempos republication confirms a La Paz mitin on June 23 plus a Cochabamba protest June 26.
continuity_status: possible continuation/resumption; relation of June actions to the February-May episode remains unresolved
limitations: February onset and May 5 suspension are only search-result-rendered evidence in this package; the June announcement is not occurrence evidence. June occurrence is supported by S005, but attendance and episode linkage remain unknown.
